comments.author: @jskong01
comments.text: There is a lot of talk about Korea becoming a rich country in decades from the poorest country on the planet, which is poorer than Africa. However, Korea is a rare country that has maintained a centralized state for 3,000 years, and it is unheard of even in the world where education and culture flourished thousands of years ago. It had been a country that used ceramics for a thousand years already, and Japan kidnapped a Korean ceramic craftsman about 300 years ago and managed to make ceramics. The world's first metal type was made and used, and its publication is where it exists. It is the place where the world's first rain gauge was invented and has been observing celestial bodies since 2000 years ago. Although there have been difficulties in the history of the past 100 years or so, the passion for education, culture, and dedication to the family have rejuvenated them.

comments.author: @user-qr1rv5ui3i
comments.text: It was a country completely devastated by the Korean War, caused by the invasion of the South by North Korean and Chinese forces. However, great leaders Syngman Rhee and Park Chung-hee established the foundation of modern Korea by forging the ROK-U.S. alliance and achieving industrialization. President Syngman Rhee led the ROK-U.S. alliance, and under U.S. support, President Park Chung-hee helped transform the nation from an agricultural country into an export-led industrial nation through the Saemaul Movement and economic development plans of the 1960s and 70s. Although it was a military regime, President Chun Doo-hwan's era employed outstanding talents, achieving remarkable economic development and hosting the Seoul Olympics. The automobile, shipbuilding, and electronics industries that Korea boasts today were established under the leadership of Presidents Park Chung-hee and Chun Doo-hwan, and their descendants are now enjoying the fruits of that labor.
